detail: cuda-oxide + CUDA 13 installed in user space on the B200 (no sudo or docker there). vLLM 0.33 baselines for Qwen3.5-0.8B, Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3.8-27B-FP8.
Rust kernels via cuda-oxide, cuBLASLt bf16 GEMMs, safetensors mmap loading. Matches transformers layer by layer on 0.8B and 9B; greedy tokens identical.
Continuous batching with chunked prefill, paged KV for full-attention layers, per-sequence DeltaNet state slots, CUDA graphs for decode, autotuned GEMM plans.
Chunked gated delta rule, tiled attention and token-parallel conv are in (CUDA cores). Next: tensor-core (mma.sync) attention and chunk matmuls.
Block-scaled FP8 GEMMs (cuBLASLt supports 128x128 block scales), so the 27B checkpoint loads.
axum OpenAI-compatible API with SSE, OTEL request spans, TTFT measured server side, then the same vllm bench serve client for both engines.
DeltaNet state snapshots at chosen prefix boundaries; speculative decoding with the checkpoint's MTP head.
sm_121 build and tuning once access is available. The B200 numbers here are a development proxy.
